data.narrative:
Aerospacelab, a Series B-stage space and aerospace company founded by Benoît Deper, has raised €200M+ to date. Valuation analysis triangulates across a comparable universe of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse) alongside stage-progression methodology, informed by a broader set of eight private and five public aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the €200M total raised proxy, yielding $380M. Peer-median analysis across the five same-sector comparables produces a median valuation of $1.5B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (26.4x median across the six-ticker Space & Aerospace universe) cannot be applied without disclosed revenue figures.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $323M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $940M. This two-method synthesis reflects material tension: the peer-median method anchors to higher valuations observed among adjacent-stage comparables, while stage-progression from capital deployed suggests more conservative pricing. Key uncertainty centers on Aerospacelab's revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to peers, particularly Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B) and the broader Sierra Space outlier ($8.0B, Series C).
